_comment: One current release per official input file. Only entries with status 'active' are published: tools/build_index.py writes them to docs/patches/index.json and copies ONLY their patch JSONs into docs/patches/. 'pending' entries are kept here until the owner releases them.

releases.title: IC-9700 E 1.50 + transverter support 1.6c
features: Transverter support: 8 slots (RF / IF), one active for MAIN and SUB
RF frequency shown on the display, CI-V frequency read/write in RF terms
SET > Transverter menu for slot entry on the radio
Per-slot maximum TX power, TX delay and PTT enable/inhibit

releases.title: IC-705 E 1.40 + transverter support 1.4D
features: Transverter support: 8 slots (TRV1–TRV8, RF / IF), RF shown on the display up to 122 GHz
CI-V frequency read/write in RF terms
Per-transverter maximum TX power and TX delay (up to 300 ms, all modes)
Custom A/B bootloader: hold POWER at power-on until the LED blinks (~3 s) to boot the other firmware slot
Opening screen shows 'customized by Dawid SQ6EMM'
Extended TX ranges and 4 m (70 MHz) TX from the E base build
